## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated.
- [ ] Docs updated (README, package README, XML docs) where behavior or API changed.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `## [Unreleased]`.
- [ ] Public API files (`PublicAPI.*.txt`) reviewed, if the public surface changed.
- [ ] Performance evidence attached if a hot path changed.
- [ ] Any new dependency is added to `eng/package-dependencies.json`.
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO).
